items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: That name sounds familiar, but I don't believe I knew him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played good boy with him.
Do you ever know a guy named Norman Mason?
That name sounds familiar, but I don't believe I knew him.

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: I've heard him, I know him.

ctx.x: I've heard him, I know him. Well, that ain't him. This guy's a big trumpet player.
Well, Norman Mason used to be a trumpet player. Yeah.
